_classes.name: self-executing fund establishment ('There is hereby established in the joint custody of') stored as a custodian duty

_classes.rule: quote starts with /^\([a-z]{1,4}\)\s/ and contains no modal (shall|must|is authorized|are authorized|is empowered|is directed|will), OR quote contains 'shall, at a minimum, include' (broad: 211 hits include legit list items under a modal lead-in; review before gating)

2017-S2393-01.quote: Any member of Kiwanis International residing in this state shall, upon request, be issued a license plate bearing the words "Kiwanis International".

2017-S2393-02.quote: Application for such license plate shall be filed with the commissioner in such form and detail as the commissioner shall prescribe.

2017-S2393-03.quote: A distinctive plate issued pursuant to this section shall be issued in the same manner as other number plates upon payment of the regular registration fee prescribed by section four hundred one of this article, provided, however, that an additional annual service charge of twenty-five dollars shall be charged for such plate.

2017-S2393-04.quote: shall only be designed, produced and issued upon the delivery to the department of motor vehicles of a surety bond in the amount of six thousand dollars
2017-S2393-04.note: Section 2/3 bond clause: 'shall only be designed, produced and issued upon the delivery to the department of motor vehicles of a surety bond' is a condition precedent on plate issuance (a private surety's delivery), not a DMV duty

2017-S2393-05.quote: All service charges collected pursuant to this section shall be deposited pursuant to the provisions of section 404-oo of the vehicle and traffic law to the credit of the department of motor vehicles distinctive plate development fund

2017-S2393-06.quote: If, upon the expiration of two years following the date upon which distinctive plates in the series are first available for sale two hundred or more sets of such plates are sold, a bond delivered pursuant to this section shall be discontinued.
2017-S2393-06.note: 'a bond delivered pursuant to this section shall be discontinued' is the release mechanics of the bond condition, a condition of another record, not a separate duty (judgment call)

2017-S2393-07.quote: If fewer than two hundred sets of such plates are sold by such time, the department of motor vehicles shall be entitled to recover against the bond in an amount of proportionate to such shortfall.
2017-S2393-07.note: 'shall be entitled to recover against the bond' = DMV power

2017-A6255-01.quote: No later than one year following the effective date of this act, the authority shall complete a study on the feasibility of:

2017-A6255-16.quote: The authority may incorporate data from relevant federal agencies, including information provided in the most recent Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey published by the U.S. Energy Information Administration, into such findings.

2017-A6255-03.quote: (a) significantly improving energy efficiency in commercial buildings through the design and construction, by owners and tenants, of separate spaces with high-performance efficiency measures;
2017-A6255-03.note: s2 item '(a) significantly improving energy efficiency...' is a topic of the -01 study ('shall complete a study on the feasibility of:'), not a separate duty; the s3 items were dropped by sub_item_of_parent, these s2 items were not
